Carrier Checks for Companion Animal Travel Desk

We are sorry when travel plans become uncertain, and the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways is here to make carrier review as clear as possible. Before arrival at the skyport, please confirm that the carrier is sturdy, clean, and secure, with enough room for your animal to stand, turn, and rest comfortably. A proper latch, safe ventilation, and an absorbent lining help our crews protect the cabin and reduce stress for your pet.

Please place travel papers where they can be reached quickly, and keep your animal calm during inspection. If your companion is a bird, <<FACT F083>>. If your companion is a small dog, <<FACT F056>>. These details are reviewed alongside the carrier itself, so please bring the same care to both items.

For short trips through our network of skyports, a soft word and a steady hand often help more than force. If your pet becomes unsettled, allow a brief pause before continuing the check. The senior coordinator may ask to see the carrier from more than one side, since small issues are easier to resolve before boarding than at the gate. We regret any inconvenience, but these steps support safer travel for all passengers and animals alike.

If anything remains unclear, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for further help before you depart.
